analysis: what the 64-anchor GradCache fine-tune learned beyond within-author whitening: descriptive part

design.cka: linear centred kernel alignment with the raw word TF-IDF space over the scope's songs, label-free
design.dropped_design: removing each space's ridge prediction from the word space was dropped after a one-fold run: fitted on songs of the same labels it strips seen-label identity through the label association alone
design.new_part: tuned whitened vectors minus their multi-output ridge prediction from the frozen whitened vectors, fitted on the training songs, alpha by generalised cross-validation over 0.1, 0.316228, 1, 3.16228, 10, 31.6228, 100, 316.228, 1000
design.reading: descriptive only; the causal test of which words the tuned advantage depends on is finetune_cue_masking_v3.py
design.runs: fine-tune tag _gradcache64, one launch per fold
design.whitening: within-author, fitted on each fold's training songs (other folds, labels not held out)
design.word_correlates: top 6 principal directions on the training songs; correlation of each unigram's TF-IDF weight (words in at least 50 songs) with all songs' coordinates; categories by jieba part of speech for the 50 strongest per direction

privacy: aggregate only; the listed words are common vocabulary in at least 50 songs, no lyric line is published
